title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
**Role Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced US IT Recruiter to support contract positions received from ARK's clients. This is an end\-to\-end recruiting position. You will understand client requirements, develop sourcing strategies, identify and engage qualified candidates, conduct meaningful screening, prepare quality submissions and remain connected with candidates through interviews, offers and start.
 



  





 The right person is curious, persistent, organized and confident speaking with candidates. You should be comfortable using established recruiting platforms while also finding creative ways to reach qualified talent.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 Understand client requirements, required skills and submission expectations.
 



 Source candidates through JobDiva, Dice, Monster, LinkedIn Recruiter, CareerBuilder, referrals, professional networks and other channels.
 



 Develop effective Boolean searches and alternate sourcing strategies.
 



 Build pipelines of qualified candidates for current and future requirements.
 



 Contact candidates through phone, email, LinkedIn and text.
 



 Explain and sell client opportunities clearly and accurately.
 



 Screen candidates for skills, experience, motivation, availability, compensation and overall fit.
 



 Prepare accurate candidate summaries and quality submissions.
 



 Maintain candidate records, activities and follow\-ups in JobDiva.
 



 Keep candidates engaged through submission, interview, offer, onboarding and start.
 



 Partner closely with the Candidate Evaluation Specialist and other recruiting team members.
 



 Meet established submission and placement expectations while maintaining quality.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 Three to five years of US IT contract recruiting experience.
 



 Experience recruiting technical professionals for contract positions.
 



 Strong Boolean\-search, database\-search and candidate\-research skills.
 



 Hands\-on experience with major job portals and LinkedIn Recruiter.
 



 Understanding of common US staffing and candidate engagement models.
 



 Strong spoken and written English.
 



 Confidence conducting candidate calls and presenting opportunities.
 



 Strong follow\-through, organization and attention to detail.
 



 Experience using an ATS; JobDiva experience is preferred.
 



 Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience.
 



 What Success Looks Like
 



 Quickly understanding requirements and developing effective searches.
 



 Consistently producing qualified—not merely available—candidates.
 



 Building strong candidate relationships and reusable talent pipelines.
 



 Maintaining accurate ATS information and dependable follow\-through.
 



 Converting submissions into interviews, offers and starts.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**The Opportunity** 




 We are hiring a Talent Acquisition Specialist to recruit ARK's India team. You may hire recruiters, marketing professionals, HR and operations staff, accountants, and other internal employees as the company grows. This is not a resume\-forwarding or interview\-scheduling position. You will be expected to find people who are not actively applying, assess whether their experience and story are credible, understand their motivation, sell ARK and the opportunity, manage the process, negotiate when needed, and stay engaged until the person joins.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




 Own internal hiring from job\-intake meeting through confirmed joining.
 



 Source through LinkedIn, Naukri, job boards, referrals, JobDiva, Boolean search, and your own professional network.
 



 Build pipelines for difficult and varied India corporate roles.
 



 Interview candidates and evaluate capability, communication, motivation, judgment, stability, and personality fit.
 



 Verify practical fit, including night shift, Noida commute, office expectations, notice period, and compensation.
 



 Identify inconsistencies in a candidate's career story and ask the follow\-up questions needed to make a sound recommendation.
 



 Keep candidates engaged, handle objections, sell ARK honestly, and reduce offer back\-outs.
 



 Maintain accurate ATS records and provide evidence\-based recommendations to hiring managers.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 Bachelor's degree in HR, Business, Psychology, or a related field.
 



 3\-7 years of hands\-on recruiting or talent acquisition experience in India.
 



 Experience recruiting across multiple functions; exposure to IT staffing, corporate hiring, professional services, or recruitment operations is valuable.
 



 ATS experience required; JobDiva strongly preferred.
 



 Hands\-on experience with LinkedIn sourcing/Recruiter, Naukri, Boolean search, referrals, and other sourcing tools.
 



 Strong knowledge of the Noida/Delhi/Client candidate market.
 



 Excellent written and spoken English, organization, judgment, persistence, and candidate\-facing communication.
 



 Willingness and ability to work onsite in Noida Sector 62 during the 6:30 pm–3:30 am IST shift.
 



 If you are someone who waits for applicants to arrive, forwards resumes without judgment, or stops after the first obstacle, this is not the right role. If you enjoy finding the right person, understanding what is really going on, and getting the hire across the line, we want to meet you.
 



  





**Why ARK?** 




 Free medical insurance
 



 Provident Fund and EPF contributions
 



 Cab facilities (Only for Female)
 



 Snacks and free meal

description:

 Iklavya is India’s first platform dedicated to training and placing youth from Tier 2–3 regions into high\-demand field sales careers. Through intensive 60\-day offline bootcamps, the organization equips young graduates with practical, job\-ready skills in sales, including product demonstrations, CRM tools, negotiation, grooming, and field exercises. Built by experienced operators, educators, and sales leaders, Iklavya emphasizes respect, speed, and measurable outcomes. **Role Description** 
 The Recruiter Intern will support end\-to\-end recruitment activities for Iklavya’s programs and internal roles in a full\-time, on\-site position based in Noida. The role also involves updating recruitment trackers, collaborating with training and operations teams to understand hiring needs, and ensuring a positive candidate experience throughout the process. * Prior internship or project experience in recruitment, HR, or community outreach is an advantage but not mandatory.

* Lead, mentor and supervise the Talent Acquisition team.

**Required Skills:** 



* 6 to 8 years of hands\-on experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment, including team\-handling experience.
* MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent qualification preferred.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end recruitment and hiring processes.
* Proven experience managing multiple positions and recruitment priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation and communication skills.
* Strong leadership and team\-management capabilities.
* Target\-oriented approach with strong follow\-up and closure skills.
* Good knowledge of HR operations, employee lifecycle processes and HR documentation.

title: Importerr is hiring ex-founders, hustlers and builders.
description:
If you've started something before, failed, paused, shut down, pivoted, or are still carrying the fire to build something big, we want to give you one fair chance.
 



 We're not hiring for one fixed department. We're hiring people with ownership.
 



  





**About Importerr:** 




 Importerr.com is a cross\-border sourcing platform that helps Indian entrepreneurs and D2C brands source directly from China. That means MOQ of 1, end\-to\-end logistics and INR payments. We work with a network of 0\.5mn\+ Chinese suppliers and brands, backed by a China\-based team and 15\+ years of cross\-border e\-commerce experience.
 



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




**People who:** 



* Think like founders, not employees
* Take ownership without waiting for daily instructions
* Are comfortable with targets, pressure and execution
* Can solve problems from zero to one
* Bring high energy, hunger and speed
* Are ready to prove themselves again
* Want to build something large with a serious company backing them



  





**What You Will Do** 




**Depending on your strength, you may lead or support areas like:** 



* **Sourcing and supplier network:** 
 supplier development, negotiation, quality checks and product discovery with our China team
* **Cross\-border logistics and supply chain:** 
 shipping, customs, clearance, last\-mile delivery, inventory and dispatch
* **D2C and brand growth:** 
 helping sellers and brand builders launch and scale winning products
* **Marketplace growth:** 
 Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, quick commerce
* **Sales and partnerships:** 
 B2B acquisition, channel partners, affiliates, influencers and educators
* **Performance marketing and content:** 
 paid ads, social, LinkedIn, video and community building
* **Founder's office projects:** 
 strategy, fundraising support, investor communication, special projects
* **Operations and process building:** 
 SOPs, CRM, automation, customer support systems
* **Finance, MIS and reconciliation:** 
 cross\-border payments, INR/CNY flows, controls and reporting
* **New business and market launches:** 
 including international expansion
* **Team building and execution systems**



  





**Why This Role Is Different** 




***This is not a normal job opening.***




 It's for people who once had the courage to start something and now need the right platform, backing and trust to prove themselves again.
 



  





**At Importerr, you'll work directly with the founder on real problems with real responsibility. You'll have access to a proven sourcing engine, a China ground team and an existing ecosystem of D2C brands and sellers. You'll have room to grow into a leadership role, and, for the right people, a path to meaningful ownership as the company scales.** 




  





**If you still believe you're meant to do something big, this role is for you.** 




  





**Ideal Background** 



* Ex\-founder, co\-founder, startup operator, business hustler or high\-ownership professional
* Experience in e\-commerce, D2C, sourcing, import/export, operations, sales, marketing, finance or SCM is preferred
* Comfort with ambiguity, a fast pace and hands\-on execution
* Failure is not a problem. Lack of hunger is.



  





**Location:** 
 Sector\-6, NOIDA
 



**Employment type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Send your resume and a short note on what you've built, attempted, or want to prove next.
 



  





**Email: rohit.jain@importerr.com** 




  





**Also, your email should to have answers to the below mentioned questions:** 



1. **Which area are you strongest in?** 
*(Sourcing / Supply chain and logistics / Sales and partnerships / Marketing and content / Marketplaces / Finance and MIS / Operations / Founder's office / Other)*
2. **What best describes your last venture's status?** 
*(Still running / Shut down / Paused / Pivoted / Never started one)*
3. **What did you build, and why did it stop or stall?** 
*(Best signal on self\-awareness and honesty about failure.)*
4. **Describe one problem you solved from zero with no instructions or resources. What did you do and what was the result?**
5. **What do you want to prove next, and why Importerr?**
6. **Give one number you personally owned, such as revenue, orders, leads or cost saved, and how you moved it.**

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Job Title
 
  
 


 About the Role
 
  
 


 Tenure \-  4 month contractual role
 
  
 


 Introduction
 
 Oxford University Press is looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and business leaders, helping to shape workforce decisions through market insight, recruitment expertise, and a deep understanding of the organisation's talent needs. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced recruitment professional who enjoys influencing stakeholders, building talent strategies, and delivering exceptional candidate experiences.
 



 As part of the Group HR function, you will play a critical role in attracting and securing high\-quality talent that supports OUP's mission of advancing knowledge and learning. You will build strong partnerships across the business, proactively develop talent pipelines, and create innovative attraction strategies that support both immediate and long\-term hiring requirements.
 



 This role provides broad exposure across all aspects of talent acquisition, including sourcing strategy, stakeholder partnering, recruitment operations, employer branding, diversity and inclusion, recruitment process improvement, and market intelligence. It offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on organisational growth while working in a collaborative and globally connected HR environment.
 


   Opportunity
 
 As a Talent Acquisition Partner, you will be responsible for managing the full recruitment lifecycle while partnering closely with hiring managers, HR colleagues, suppliers, and candidates to deliver a high\-quality recruitment experience.
 



 Key responsibilities include:
 


* Partnering with hiring managers and HR business partners to source and attract outstanding talent in line with organisational design and reward principles.
* Developing recruitment plans for hiring managers using data, market intelligence, sourcing insights, and cost considerations to support informed hiring decisions.
* Building long\-term relationships with business stakeholders to understand immediate and future workforce requirements.
* Creating and implementing attraction strategies and talent pipelines to support business objectives and workforce planning.
* Proactively seeking market intelligence and candidate insights to build high\-quality talent pools.
* Engaging with potential candidates through direct sourcing, networking, recruitment events, social media platforms, and talent communities.
* Working towards direct hiring objectives and reducing dependency on external agencies wherever appropriate.
* Coaching hiring managers through every stage of the end\-to\-end recruitment process.
* Advising managers on effective assessment and selection methods to identify the best candidates.
* Championing diversity and inclusion throughout the recruitment process and supporting diverse shortlists.
* Promoting awareness of unconscious bias and inclusive hiring practices among hiring managers.
* Keeping up to date with recruitment legislation and communicating relevant updates to hiring managers and HR stakeholders.
* Delivering coaching sessions, briefings, and guidance on recruitment policies, legal requirements, and best practices.
* Managing recruitment operations to ensure candidates are assessed, selected, offered, vetted, and onboarded in accordance with OUP policies and procedures.
* Managing preferred supplier relationships and ensuring agencies remain compliant, effective, and aligned with OUP's values and requirements.
* Collaborating with HR Operations and wider HR teams to ensure recruitment processes and systems are efficient and effective.
* Driving continuous improvement within recruitment processes through training, feedback, process enhancement, and knowledge sharing initiatives.
* Delivering recruitment system and process training to hiring managers and stakeholders.
* Ensuring Information Security and Data Privacy requirements are maintained throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
* Implementing appropriate controls to mitigate data privacy risks and ensure responsible handling of candidate information.
* Working cross\-functionally with colleagues across HR services, operations, projects, and change initiatives to support business objectives and organisational alignment.
* Supporting additional projects and duties that contribute to OUP's wider mission and operational goals.


   Impact
 
 This role is central to OUP's ability to attract, engage, and retain outstanding talent. By providing expert recruitment guidance, building strong talent pipelines, supporting inclusive hiring practices, and delivering an excellent candidate experience, you will directly contribute to the organisation's success and future growth. Your work will strengthen workforce capability, support business performance, and enhance OUP's reputation as an employer of choice.
 


   About You   Essential Criteria

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
Every day, millions of vehicle owners depend on dealership service departments to keep them on the road. We build the software that helps those service teams communicate with customers, schedule repairs, approve work, collect payments, and deliver a better experience from start to finish.
   

  

 myKaarma is a leading SaaS platform serving dealerships across North America. Headquartered in Long Beach, California, with a global team, we're growing by solving real operational problems with practical technology.
   

  

 We believe the best ideas come from people who take ownership, question how things can be improved, and care deeply about the customer experience. If you're excited to build products that have measurable impact, we'd love to meet you.
   

  

**Role Description**
 myKaarma is looking for a hands\-on Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to help us identify and hire exceptional talent as we continue to grow in India.
   

  

 This role is well suited for someone who combines the energy and execution needed for high\-volume recruiting with the judgment, organization, and technical fluency required to recruit for a growing software company. You will own searches from initial planning through offer acceptance while also building scalable programs for campus hiring, employee referrals, interview events, and candidate assessment.
   

  

 The right person is a strong recruiter and project manager; someone who can turn a hiring goal into a clear plan, coordinate many moving pieces, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and create an excellent candidate experience.
   

  

**How To Stand Out**
 This role requires more than strong recruiting fundamentals. We are looking for a technical thinker who can diagnose difficult hiring challenges, test new approaches, and create experiences that make exceptional candidates want to join myKaarma.
   

  

 Here is an example of the type of scenario we may explore:
   

  

 Question:
 
**You need to hire 25 high\-quality software engineers within 90 days, but myKaarma has limited employer\-brand awareness in a highly competitive market. Job postings and traditional outreach are not producing enough qualified candidates. How would you approach the challenge?**
 What will help you stand out:
 **First, I’d work backward from 25 hires in 90 days to establish the required hiring pace, or takt time, and map the recruiting funnel to identify the constraint.**
**I might create a recurring myKaarma Engineering Challenge Day. We would invite a curated group of engineers to solve a realistic, sanitized product problem alongside members of our engineering team. Candidates would experience how we work, meet future colleagues, and demonstrate their technical thinking through the work itself.**
**The event would combine assessment, employer branding, and interviews into one structured experience, with standardized evaluation criteria and same\-day decisions. After each event, I would review conversion data and candidate feedback, identify where candidates stalled or disengaged, and improve the next session.**
**The goal would be to create a repeatable hiring system that improves speed and quality while giving strong engineers an experience they would talk about, even if they were not hired.**
 We are not looking for one “right” answer. We want to see how you break down the problem, use data to identify constraints, and develop solutions beyond standard recruiting tactics. Ultimately, we want to understand how you would make myKaarma a company talented people actively compete to join.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead full\-cycle recruiting for software, technology, and other priority roles in India.
* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, sourcing strategies, interview plans, and selection criteria.
* Build and manage campus recruiting programs, including university partnerships, hiring events, assessments, interview days, and offer coordination.
* Design and execute high\-volume recruiting initiatives such as referral campaigns, pre\-hire testing, recruiting drives, and structured interview days.
* Develop sourcing strategies that create strong, diverse pipelines through direct outreach, referrals, campus relationships, professional networks, and other channels.
* Evaluate candidates for both technical capability and alignment with myKaarma’s hiring standards.
* Maintain recruiting plans, timelines, candidate data, and stakeholder updates across multiple concurrent searches.
* Coordinate interview teams and ensure candidates move through the process efficiently and consistently.
* Use recruiting data to assess pipeline health, identify bottlenecks, and improve hiring outcomes.
* Maintain accurate and timely information in our applicant tracking system.
* Represent myKaarma at campus programs, recruiting events, and company locations as needed.
* Help strengthen and standardize recruiting practices as the company scales.


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* At least five years of recruiting experience, with a meaningful focus on software, technology, and campus hiring.
* Demonstrated success managing high\-volume recruiting programs, such as interview days, campus drives, referral campaigns, or pre\-hire assessment processes.
* Strong understanding of technical roles and the ability to engage credibly with candidates and hiring managers; prior technical education or professional experience is a plus.
* Excellent project management skills, with the ability to organize complex initiatives, manage deadlines, and coordinate multiple stakeholders.
* Clear, proactive written and verbal communication.
* Strong sourcing, candidate assessment, and stakeholder\-management capabilities.
* Experience managing multiple searches and priorities in a fast\-moving environment.
* Proficiency with applicant tracking systems; experience with Rippling is preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate recruiting data.
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 25% for campus recruiting, hiring events, or on\-site collaboration.


**We value diverse experiences and backgrounds, so we encourage you to apply if you meet some but not all of the listed qualifications. Skills can be learned—we also value curiosity, ownership, and a willingness to grow.**
****Total Rewards at myKaarma****
**Benefits**
 At myKaarma, we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that extends beyond the base salary. Our commitment to competitive compensation includes bonuses and benefits that support both personal and professional well\-being:
   

  

* Flexible Work Environment: We embrace a high\-performance, flexible structure that values freedom and responsibility. Our “Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled” model empowers teams to innovate and continuously improve using data\-driven insights.
* Health and Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits, along with wellness and telework stipends.
* Time Off: Generous vacation time to recharge and balance life outside work.
* In\-Office Perks: Enjoy dog\-friendly offices and unlimited snacks or refreshments onsite.


 The starting salary range for this role is \[hiring target], depending on experience and qualifications, reflecting our dedication to competitive industry compensation. Additional details about our Total Rewards package will be shared during recruitment.
